title: MediWise Signal Frame
description: Domain-neutral intermediate representation for MediWise 健康译报. Produced by shared/story/adapters/<domain>.py, consumed by the selector, the motion layer, and the renderers. Renderers must read all domain wording from `lexicon` and must never reference a specific domain, unit, or metric name directly.

domain.description: Which health domain this frame narrates. Selector uses it for eligibility and template domain tags only, never for aesthetics.

lexicon.description: Per-domain wording table. All user-visible domain nouns come from here.

up.description: Neutral direction word. Must not imply success, failure, or progress.

down.description: Neutral direction word. Must not imply success, failure, or progress.

scope_label.description: Statistical scope, e.g. 有记录日. Averages must always carry it.

series.description: Same-day-folded daily points, ascending by date. Drives `draw`, `settle`, and `trace`. May be empty for zero-data frames.

count.description: Raw measurements folded into this point. >1 enables the double-exposure moment.

fold.description: How same-day duplicates were folded. Never `sum` for a level-type reading.

relative_only.description: When true the renderer must plot deltas from the series baseline, never absolute values. Required true whenever show_exact_reading is false.

baseline.description: Baseline used for relative plotting. Omitted from all user-visible output.

quantized_gaps.description: True when `settle` intervals were bucketed to avoid leaking exact dates.

shape.description: Shared narrative shape. Copy is keyed on this, never on a per-domain state, so template copy stays O(templates x shapes).

claim_allowed.description: False blocks every trend sentence and every trend-requiring template.

delta.description: Robust change across the window, in `lexicon.unit`.

latest_delta.description: Change between the two most recent recorded points.

latest_deviation.description: Latest point minus the robust fit at that date.

visual_strength.description: Unitless signed direction consistency for visual encoding only: median pairwise slope divided by median absolute pairwise slope. Not a health magnitude or a second estimate.

method.description: Estimator identifier, e.g. theil_sen. Same-day folding is declared separately by series_meta.fold.

repeat_days.description: Days holding more than one raw measurement.

facts.description: Pre-formatted, privacy-safe evidence lines. Templates select and reorder these; they never recompute numbers.

value_text.description: Already rendered, already redacted, already signed. Includes unit when relevant.

relative.description: False means the text carries an absolute reading and is gated behind show_exact_reading.

companions.description: Reduced frames for the other domains observed in the same window. Replaces the weight-specific `management` block.

fact.description: One same-period sentence for this companion domain.

situation.description: Deterministic stage portrait. Not a health score and not encouragement copy.

summary.description: Full synthesis paragraph including the non-causal boundary sentence.

social_packaging.description: Share framing. May only amplify facts already confirmed in `facts` and `situation`.

persona.description: Observer identity derived only from recording behavior. Never from readings, direction, BMI, sex, age, diagnosis, medication, or goal completion.

motion.description: Deterministic motion parameters derived from the style seed and coverage. Same seed plus same data must yield a byte-identical SVG.

motion_mode.description: Globally unique per template, alongside content_role and layout_mode.

tempo.description: Beats per second for calendar-mapped settle.

duration_ms.description: One loop, excluding the trailing hold.

poster_time_ms.description: Frozen frame timestamp used for PNG export.

beats.description: Calendar-mapped settle beats: one entry per series point, gap_days carrying the real interval so missing days become perceptible silence.

gap_bucket.description: Bucketed gap used when exact dates are redacted.

reduced_motion_fallback.description: prefers-reduced-motion must degrade to the poster frame.

limits.description: Boundary flags the renderer surfaces verbatim. All four must hold for every frame.

cross_domain_arithmetic.description: Deriving a balance by subtracting one domain from another is forbidden.
